title: Weil second-prime exact two-shift split certificate contract
description: Certificate-first contract for the second-prime window (1/2 log3, log2). The certificate carries frozen parameters and identities ONLY. Matrices, eigenvalues, pivots, cross-term magnitudes, positivity conclusions and any self-reported numeric result are deliberately absent and rejected as unknown fields (additionalProperties:false); the checker recomputes them. Two-prime specific: both prime shifts (tau_2, tau_3) and the cross-prime term F must be declared present.

window.description: Second-prime window (1/2 log3, log2); both n=2,3 in single-hop regime.

radius.description: L as an exact rational strictly inside the window; the checker verifies 1/2 log3 < L < log2 by certified rational bounds, not enumeration.

tail_degree.description: First complement degree d = 2N (even) / 2N+1 (odd). The checker verifies d matches sector+N.

primes.description: The two primes in the single-hop regime. Must be exactly [2, 3]; the checker rejects any other set (guards against a first-window single-prime certificate masquerading as second-window).

prime_layer.description: Declares that BOTH prime shifts and the cross-prime term are present. Omitting any is the C11 bug class; the checker rejects a certificate that declares any of these absent, AND recomputes to confirm each is actually present and nonzero.

S0_definition.description: Full four-term second moment. S_KK-only is the retired inflation bug and is rejected.
